title: ML/DS Interview Questions & Answers (500+)
subtitle: 500+ ML/DS interview Q&A with 10 categories and 3 difficulty levels
description: A curated collection of 500+ machine learning and data science interview questions with detailed, expert-level answers. Perfect for interview preparation, building ML tutoring chatbots, text classification, and NLP tasks. Each question includes category, difficulty level, company tags, and topic tags.

resources.description: 500+ ML/DS interview questions with detailed answers, categorized by topic, difficulty, and company tags

fields.name: id
fields.title: Question ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for each question (SHA-256 hash)

fields.name: category
fields.title: Category
fields.description: Topic category: Statistics, ML Theory, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, System Design, SQL, Python, Feature Engineering, or A/B Testing

fields.name: difficulty
fields.title: Difficulty Level
fields.description: Question difficulty: easy, medium, or hard

fields.name: company_tags
fields.title: Company Tags
fields.description: Pipe-separated company names where this question type is commonly asked (Google, Meta, Amazon, etc.)

fields.name: topic_tags
fields.title: Topic Tags
fields.description: Pipe-separated specific topic labels for fine-grained filtering

fields.name: answer_length
fields.title: Answer Word Count
fields.description: Number of words in the answer
